contract.sharing_contract: anyone-with-the-link EDIT (Drive permission type=anyone, role=writer) is intentional and must be preserved; never migrate to named-user-only (F02).
contract.idempotency_contract: Caller must serialize company_id::planner_kind in a durable lease. Drive files.copy stamps ownership and initializing state atomically; every retry reads back, resumes pending formatting or returns verified ready file. Ambiguous/multiple/unowned matches fail closed. Never retry a copy blindly.

repair_contract.verification: F14 — BEFORE provisioning completes, the template sheet's metadata is read with the SAME credential class the copy uses (googleDriveOAuth2Api), verifying the template is reachable and expected to exist. The provisioned sheet's metadata is then read back with the Sheets credential the appends use (Verify Provisioned Sheet + Registry Verification step in INSTALL.md) before the receipt is returned.
repair_contract.transient: GET nodes retry at most three times. Mutating calls surface errors without automatic retries; caller reconciles same provisioning identity and resumes.
repair_contract.classification: 404 on the template => 'template_not_found' (identity repair: fix templateSheetId). 403 => 'template_access_denied' (access repair: re-grant operator access to the EXISTING template). Neither ever silently creates a replacement sheet.

error_schema.repair_action: specific actionable repair instruction (identity vs access)

input_schema.templateSheetId: string (required, Google Sheet ID of the fleet template)

output_schema.sharedWith: literal(anyone with the link can edit)

credential_references: googleDriveOAuth2Api on Drive HTTP and Set Anyone Can Edit; googleSheetsOAuth2Api on all Sheets HTTP calls. Bind through prepare-import.py; never commit actual credentials.

parameters.jsCode: const t=$input.first().json;const s=$('Validate + Build Provisioning Key').first().json;if(t.id!==s.templateSheetId || t.trashed || t.mimeType!=='application/vnd.google-apps.spreadsheet')throw new Error('Registered template is not an accessible, non-trashed Google Sheet');return [{json:t}];

const expected=[["row_key", "company_id", "cycle_id", "content_revision", "account_id", "platform", "account_name", "format", "scheduled_local", "scheduled_utc", "state", "qc_state", "preview_url", "remote_url"], ["asset_key", "content_id", "asset_id", "company_id", "cycle_id", "content_revision", "kind", "preview_url", "original_url", "ratio", "width", "height", "alt_text", "qc_state"], ["video_key", "content_id", "asset_id", "company_id", "cycle_id", "content_revision", "version", "poster_url", "published_url", "watch_url", "duration_seconds", "ratio", "captions", "qc_state"], ["Week Of", "Theme of the Week", "Research", "Core Content", "Images", "Videos", "Facebook", "Instagram", "LinkedIn", "YouTube", "TikTok", "Pinterest", "Carousels", "Blog", "Podcast", "Email", "QC", "Scheduled", "Overall", "Notes"], ["Week", "Client", "Next Action", "Drafting", "QC", "Scheduled", "Published", "Needs Attention"]];const v=$input.first().json.valueRanges;if(!Array.isArray(v)||v.length!==expected.length)throw new Error('Missing existing planner headers');expected.forEach((h,i)=>{if(JSON.stringify(v[i].values?.[0])!==JSON.stringify(h))throw new Error('Existing planner header mismatch; preserving structural repair required');});return [{json:{verified:true}}];
